findings.title: Security group or rule without description
findings.description: Hygiene: Security groups and their rules should carry descriptions so reviewers understand their purpose. Add a description attribute.
findings.expected: description on each inline egress rule
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Key Vault not using RBAC authorization
findings.description: azurerm_key_vault with enable_rbac_authorization = false uses legacy access policies. Prefer Azure RBAC for centralized access control.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Azure security best practices and the CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Key Vault not using premium SKU
findings.description: azurerm_key_vault with sku_name = "standard" lacks HSM-backed keys. Use premium SKU for hardware-protected keys.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Azure security best practices and the CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Key Vault network ACLs allow public traffic
findings.description: azurerm_key_vault without a network_acls block (default allow) or with default_action other than "Deny" accepts secret/key operations from any network. Set default_action = "Deny" with explicit allowances.
findings.remediation: Remove public exposure. Restrict ingress to known CIDR ranges, disable public network access (`public_network_access_enabled = false`), and use private endpoints / Private Link if external access is required. Verify with `az network nsg rule list`.
